description: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED says what --yes would do: the old signing secret stops working now.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: This service operation requires explicit confirmation.
Detail: --yes is required because it invalidates the current signing secret now; deliveries signed with the old secret are refused until the sender uses the new one
Planned: Rotate a webhook job's signing secret.
Confirm with: prose cli job rotate-secret 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10 --yes
Preview with: prose cli job rotate-secret 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10 --preview
Action: Rerun the same command with --yes to confirm, or with --preview to see what it would do without sending anything.
